title: Benchmark environment: pinned driver/CUDA images and runner matrix for stable tokens/sec p95 baselines
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Define and implement a standardized benchmark environment for tokens/sec and p95 latency baselines. This ticket pins NVIDIA drivers, CUDA/CuDNN versions, and container images across our benchmark fleet and defines the runner matrix (GPU types and runner configurations) used by automated load tests. Goal: make long-term performance signal comparable across runs and enable deterministic regression detection.
benchmark_matrix: Driver versions: NVIDIA driver 535.54.03 (A100/H100 baseline), 525.125 (T4) pinned per image
CUDA versions: cuda-12.1 for A100/H100 runs, cuda-11.8 for T4 compatibility runs
Runners: github-action-runner-gpu (ephemeral), k8s-benchmark-runner (nodepool-bench), dedicated-batch-pool for high-concurrency tests
Workload patterns: single-stream low-latency, multi-stream batch (batch sizes 1..8), concurrent sessions (100, 500, 2000 requests)
Metrics captured: tokens/sec (steady-state), p95 latency per request, p50/p99, GPU util, memory, kernel stalls, power draw (where available)
regression_detection_plan: 1) Establish baseline from 5 golden runs per GPU/CUDA/image combo and store artifacts in s3://rwinf-bench/baselines/runtime-2.4/; 2) Run CI daily and on PRs that touch runtime, collecting tokens/sec and p95; 3) Use statistical test: pairwise bootstrap on tokens/sec and p95 with 95% confidence, flag >5% degradation OR 10ms p95 increase; 4) Automated alert to #infra-bench on Slack with link to Grafana + artifacts; 5) If flagged, capture KV cache hit/miss traces and rerun with profiler enabled; 6) Triage SLO: P0 if regression affects >=2 runner types or customer-visible endpoints.
progress_updates: 2026-02-18: Spec drafted by Ava; initial matrix proposed after reviewing 2025-12 historical runs.
2026-02-23: CI image build pipeline added (GH actions): rwinf/bench:cuda12.1-cudnn8-2026-02-15 (PR #4123).
2026-03-01: First smoke runs completed on A100 and T4; tokens/sec variance within 3% between runs on same node type.
2026-03-05: Observed p95 drift (~12ms) on H100 nightly runs vs baseline; created ENG-4747 to investigate kernel selection differences.
2026-03-08: Review with PM (Marta Ruiz) and SRE (Jordan Lee). PM requested adding dedicated dedicated-batch-pool runs to better represent customer burst traffic.
2026-03-10: Implemented automated artifact upload and baseline storage; regression detection job scheduled daily at 03:00 UTC.
decision_log: 2026-02-20: Decided to pin driver versions inside runner images rather than relying on host drivers to improve reproducibility (trade-off: more image churn; benefit: consistent kernels).
2026-02-27: Chose cuda-12.1 as primary baseline for A100/H100 due to supported optimized kernels in our runtime. T4 will remain on cuda-11.8 for broad test coverage.
2026-03-04: Agreed threshold for automated regression alert: >=5% tokens/sec drop OR >10ms p95 increase over baseline with 95% bootstrap confidence.
notes: Trade-offs documented: pinning images reduces 'works-for-me' variability but requires patch cadence for security updates. Plan includes quarterly driver/CUDA review and emergency hotfix path. Next steps: land image promotion PR, add k8s node taints for benchmark pool, run 20 golden runs for final baseline solidification.
